answer: Inter-Arrival Jitter Fingerprinting.** Each identity must submit a fixed count of lightweight heartbeat packets whose inter-arrival gaps are drawn from a heavy-tailed distribution seeded per identity, resembling quartz irregularity rather than a metronome. The verifier scores traffic-shape entropy across an atlas of rolling windows and flags uniform spacing as synthetic. To pass, an attacker must emulate realistic jitter per identity, forcing dedicated scheduling and bandwidth per sybil, so marginal cost scales linearly with fleet size instead of collapsing to a single ivory registry entry.
